messages:
omar_procurement: Heads up 1: vendor updated lead times for H100 tranche on PO# 2026-08-01. ETA pushed +2.5 weeks. They proposed splitting the shipment: 55% AMS, 45% FRA. SLA note: AMS can expedite but adds freight.

linda_ops: Do we have a risk map for concentrating units in FRA? Customs backlog there has been flakey.

omar_procurement: Risk map attached in vendor email but TL;DR: FRA has higher customs variance. Carrier suggests FRA for bulk but AMS for urgent loaners.

anna_logistics: Carrier bot reports FRA AWB 1ZFRAXXXXXX on hold pending HS code clarification. They need commercial invoice + PO copy uploaded. I'll do upload now.

carrier_bot: Update: AWB 1ZFRAXXXXXX - customs hold. Docs required: commercial invoice, packing list, and PO reference. Upload via portal or email customs@carrier.example. Expected clearance window 48-96h after docs accepted.

jess_enginfra: If FRA is uncertain, let's reserve AMS units as warm spares for na-west2 and pin FRA to non-critical zones (long-tail). I'll prepare a small config change to route critical pools to AMS-first.

kai_sre: FYI AMS->na-west2 adds ~10-15ms p50 and small tail penalties during cold KV-cache misses. We should only route latency-critical traffic to AMS if needed. Also monitor inter-region egress cost: ~ $0.035/token-equivalent extra on peak.

linda_ops: For RMA: depot flagged 3 DOA units -> RMA-12288. Options: (A) depot repair (~7-12 days) or (B) AMS loaners shipped overnight (extra freight ~$5.5k). What do we pick?

omar_procurement: Vendor offered temporary loaners from AMS for 5 days and 40% freight credit if we accept partial air. Seeking written confirmation now. If we go depot repair we should ask for expedited depot turn around under warranty.

anna_logistics: Uploaded docs at 2026-08-05T11:03Z. Carrier portal updated. Will post clearance flag.

jess_enginfra: I'm +1 for AMS loaners if vendor confirms and freight credit applied. I'll toggle routing and create a canary to divert non-critical inference to quantized variants to preserve H100s.

kai_sre: Actionable checklist: 1) anna: confirm customs clearance. 2) omar: get loaner commitment in writing and AWB for AMS loaners. 3) jess: PR for route/pool fallback and canary. 4) linda: inventory audit on warm-spare counts and escalate if any pool <2.

omar_procurement: Vendor wrote back: "We can supply 3 loaner H100 units from AMS (7-day loan) + 40% freight credit on overnight. AWB for loaners: 1ZAMSSHIP001. Will amend PO." Sending amendment now.

linda_ops: Good. I'll run spare audit and post results in 20m. If any pool <2 we'll accept loaners.

anna_logistics: Customs cleared at 2026-08-07T09:41Z (portal accepted docs). FRA AWB 1ZFRAXXXXXX status: released to carrier.

omar_procurement: Loaners shipped from AMS (AWB 1ZAMSSHIP001). Carrier ETA to na-west2 depot: 2026-08-08 overnight. Freight credit applied to PO as vendor promised.

jess_enginfra: Routing PR opened: pin FRA to low-priority pools and AMS as warm-spare; fallback to quantized-llama-variant for non-critical routes. Monitor metrics after switch; I'll add a dashboard.

kai_sre: I'll watch tail latency & error budget while loaners are in rotation. Notify me when loaners are accepted into inventory.

anna_logistics: Loaners delivered to depot at 2026-08-08T07:26Z and checked in under temp IDs. RMA-12288 depot repair queued but paused since loaners cover immediate need.

omar_procurement: Closing loop: PO amendment sent, loaners arrived, customs cleared. Tag me if any regressions. :thumbsup:
